setup.command: Create a temporary HOME, place only the selected agent command stub on PATH, and serve a local source archive fixture to the unmodified public command bash docs/install.sh.

Install(a).command: Run bash docs/install.sh with only agent a detected in the isolated HOME/PATH.

Inspect(a).command: List regular files in the mapped target directory for agent a without modifying it.

state.installed: For each agent, read the set of regular-file basenames in its mapped target; a nonexistent directory maps to the empty set.
state.result: Read the normalized result emitted by the most recent Install or Inspect adapter action. Before any action it is idle.
